_comment: App layer of the console for the CanBank (ibac) usecase: the sections behind the nav, and the action cards on each. Every action sends its prompt through the normal orchestrator pipeline; '{input}' is replaced by the card's input field. render hints the presenter: details | docs | table | case | weather | text | auto. access: 'request' offers a Request-access button when a gateway denies the action. A group's audience (customer | staff; absent = everyone) selects who sees it; the role comes from staff_check - here the explain queries' staff leg: staff are the people who WORKS_IN a department that CAN_TRIGGER the workflow. services: the gateways a card depends on - only their NOT AUTHORIZED decisions show on the card.
placeholder: Ask about your accounts, family, documents, quotes or invoices…

sections.label: Accounts
sections.title: Accounts
sections.intro: Invoices from the ERP. The rows are filtered by the graph before any SQL runs: each person sees their slice - staff the customers their department serves, customers their own, parents their minor children's.

groups.title: Family
